candidates.change_summary: Replace betLimit = amount; with betLimit = amount + 1; so AdjustBetAmounts sets a different betLimit.
Replace betLimit = amount; with betLimit = amount - 1; so AdjustBetAmounts sets a different betLimit.
Replace betLimit = amount; with betLimit = amount * 2; so AdjustBetAmounts sets a different betLimit.
Replace betLimit = amount; with betLimit = 0; so AdjustBetAmounts always sets betLimit to zero.
Replace betLimit = amount; with betLimit = amount / 2; so AdjustBetAmounts sets a smaller betLimit.

Change require(msg.sender == owner); to require(msg.sender != owner); which inverts ownership check making AdjustBetAmounts callable only by non-owners and thus can change betLimit observable by callers.
Change require(msg.sender == owner); to require(msg.sender == address(0)); so only the zero address can call owner-only functions, preventing normal owner from changing betLimit.
Change require(msg.sender == owner); to require(true); removing owner restriction so anyone can call AdjustBetAmounts and thus potentially change betLimit.
